title: Experimental upgrade funnel and telemetry-gated rollout for runtime versioning
creator: Marisol Reyes
description: Create an experimental self-serve upgrade funnel for customers on older runtime/model variants that is gated by telemetry signals. Goal is to reduce manual migration support while keeping regressions <1% and having an automated rollback path. Deliverables: customer-facing upgrade checklist, in-product nudge flow, release-notes templates, telemetry dashboards and automated canary gating rules, support playbook and rollback runbook.
acceptance_criteria: In-product opt-in upgrade flow built and behind feature flag for 10% of accounts
Telemetry dashboard with per-cohort quality and latency deltas visible in Console (latency, mean loss, error rate)
Automated gating rule that pauses expansion if regression >1.5% or latency increases >25ms sustained for 30m
Release notes and migration checklist published to Docs and linked from Console
Support playbook with FAQs, rollback runbook, and triage routing configured
Post-upgrade survey capturing qualitative feedback for first 250 upgrades

cross_team_tasks: Engineering: implement opt-in flow, feature flag, telemetry hooks, and automated gating API
Developer Experience: add contextual docs and an in-product migration checklist
Support/CS: prepare canned responses, support routing, and a dedicated Slack channel #migration-runway
Design: UX for opt-in modal, progress indicators, and survey flow
Security & Compliance: review data capture for telemetry and ensure no PII is collected
Marketing: coordinate release notes, in-product banners, and customer email cadence
Legal/Procurement: prepare contract notes for enterprise customers on opt-in changes
communications: Pre-launch: Internal kickoff doc (Confluence) and 30-min walkthrough with Support and Sales
Day-of: In-product banner for eligible customers + targeted email to cohorts
Post-upgrade: Automated in-console survey + aggregate summary sent to CS
Weekly: Standup with cross-functional leads M/W/F during experimental window
Release notes: canonical doc + short changelog entry and example migration snippets for SDKs
metrics_kpis: Quality delta (mean token-level loss or score) pre vs post
HTTP error rate change (5xx/4xx) for upgraded requests
risks_mitigations: Risk: Undetected quality regression — Mitigation: conservative initial cohort + automated gating at 1.5% regression
Risk: Increased latency for large-sequence workloads — Mitigation: limit initial experiments to <512 token requests and add per-tenant throttles
Risk: High support load — Mitigation: dedicated CS on-call during rollout and pre-baked support scripts
Risk: Enterprise contract objections — Mitigation: opt-out path and account-level migration concierge for top 50 customers
rollback_triggers: Sustained regression >1.5% over 30 minutes for any monitored prompt-set
Median latency increase >25ms sustained over 30 minutes for 3 consecutive sampling windows
Increase in user-reported critical bugs tied to model output >2x baseline
More than 15% of opt-ins open support tickets within 48 hours
